game_intent.json.original_prompt: Create a dark top-down dungeon adventure where I explore an ancient crypt, fight skeleton guards, discover a hidden key, unlock a sealed chamber, and claim a magical relic. quests.text: Defeat the skeleton guard patrolling the outer crypt.
Defeat the skeleton elite guarding the crypt.
Discover the hidden crypt key.
Unlock the sealed chamber door using the crypt key.
Claim the magical relic from the inner sanctuary.
